line_zh: 一座可以走进去的 3D 柑橘港湾，日落、夜景、清晨会自己流转。
line_en: A 3D citrus harbor you can walk into, drifting from sunset to night to dawn on its own.
lead_zh: 用 Three.js 程序化搭建的港湾主题公园，约 220×150 米，分柑橘集市、植物温室、灯塔高地、僵尸船坞、梯田小镇五个区域。可以总览环绕，也可以用第一或第三人称步行、飞行；喷泉、温室、灯塔、吊机、罐头厂靠近都能互动，还有在线排行榜和港湾留言。
lead_en: A procedurally built harbor theme park in Three.js, about 220 × 150 m across five districts. Orbit the whole island, or walk and fly through it in first or third person. The fountain, greenhouse, lighthouse, crane and cannery all respond when you walk up, and there is a live leaderboard and guestbook.

line_zh: 一池可以触摸的水。划过水面泛起涟漪，靠近锦鲤会游过来，轻点一下投下鱼食。
line_en: A pond you can touch: ripples follow your cursor, koi swim over to you, and a tap drops food.
lead_zh: 涟漪来自实时的水面波动模拟，水底的光纹会跟着弯折；每条锦鲤都有自己的巡游、靠近、抢食和散开。没人操作的时候，水面也会偶尔自己泛起涟漪。
lead_en: Ripples come from a real-time wave simulation that bends the light on the pond floor. Each koi cruises, approaches, feeds and scatters on its own, and the water stirs now and then even when no one is touching it.

line_zh: 远看是一颗完整的小地球，拉近就进入城市和地貌的立体沙盘。
line_en: From afar it is a whole tiny planet; zoom in and you land in a 3D diorama of a city or landscape.
lead_zh: 18 座城市、12 类自然地貌，共 30 个沙盘。地球俯冲到目的地后，沙盘从平面隆起，楼宇生长、树木冒出；可以切换清晨、正午、黄昏、夜晚，开启环游世界自动导览，或把当前视角冲印成明信片。
lead_en: 30 dioramas: 18 cities and 12 kinds of landscape. Fly down to a place and the ground rises, buildings grow and trees sprout. Switch between dawn, noon, dusk and night, take an automatic world tour, or print the current view as a postcard.

line_zh: 移动鼠标，和戴着耳机的毛绒 Jolly 对上目光。也可以拉近看看，安静地陪伴一会儿。
line_en: Move your pointer to meet Jolly's gaze. Come closer to this headphone-wearing plush companion, or pause and stay a while.
lead_zh:
戴着耳机的奶油色毛绒伙伴，会随着鼠标或手指的移动轻轻转头。可以暂停跟随、回到正面，也可以拉近看看卷绒、五官和耳机。

95 张 Blender 原生渲染保留细密卷绒，身体毛发保持稳定，头部自然跟随。角色、背景字和贴地阴影融在同一画面中，全景完整展示耳机、手和脚；“关于 Jolly”里还可以打开 Three.js 三维探索。
lead_en:
A cream-colored plush companion in headphones gently turns its head toward your pointer or touch. Pause its gaze, return to the front, or come closer to see the fleece, face and headphones.

95 native Blender renders preserve the fine fleece, with a stable body and a head that follows your gaze. The character, background lettering and contact shadows share one rendered scene. The full view keeps the headphones, hands and feet visible; About Jolly also offers a separate Three.js exploration mode.

title_zh: SUGAR 粒子 · 黑底荧光
line_zh: 荧光粒子聚成 SUGAR。移过鼠标，拨动光点，移开后慢慢归位。
line_en: Lime particles gather into SUGAR. Move your pointer to stir the dots, then let them spring back.
lead_zh:
全屏黑底上，黄绿色粒子从散布状态收敛为 SUGAR。鼠标经过字母时，附近的粒子会被推开，并随移动方向产生轻微拖曳；移开鼠标或松开手指后，光点弹性归位。

点击“进入”，粒子向外散开，露出同页首页，地址不变。支持手机触屏，可直接在浏览器体验。
lead_en:
Yellow-green particles on a black canvas gather into SUGAR. Moving across the letters pushes nearby dots aside with a little directional drag. Move away or lift your finger and the dots spring home.

Choose Enter to scatter the particles and reveal the homepage without changing the URL. Mouse and touch input are supported.

title_zh: SUGAR 粒子 · 白底黑点
line_zh: 白色画布上的黑色粒子，随鼠标散开、牵动，再弹回 SUGAR。
line_en: Black particles on a white canvas scatter and follow your pointer, then spring back into SUGAR.
lead_zh:
白色画布上，大小不一的黑色粒子从散布状态收敛为 SUGAR。鼠标经过字母时，附近的粒子会被推开，并随移动方向产生轻微拖曳；移开鼠标或松开手指后，光点弹性归位。

点击“进入”，粒子向外散开，露出同页首页，地址不变。支持手机触屏，可直接在浏览器体验。
lead_en:
Black particles of different sizes gather into SUGAR on a white canvas. Moving across the letters pushes nearby dots aside with a little directional drag. Move away or lift your finger and the dots spring home.

Choose Enter to scatter the particles and reveal the homepage without changing the URL. Mouse and touch input are supported.

line_zh: U 盘自动向前，对准接口，再翻个面。插对继续加速，插错就得重来。
line_en: Keep the USB moving: line up with the port and flip it the right way. Plug in to speed up; miss and start again.
lead_zh:
一个斜上方桌面视角的 3D 小游戏。U 盘持续向前，电脑从上方落下；用方向键、A/D 或手指滑动，在三个接口位置之间移动，再用空格或翻转按钮切换正反面。

插对后电脑散架，下一段速度提高 5%；插错则本局结束。昵称会保存在本机，结束后自动保存成绩。可以查看全国排行榜与全部挑战历史，桌面侧栏和手机弹窗都提供操作演示。
lead_en:
A 3D runner viewed from above the desk. The USB moves forward while computers drop into its path. Use arrow keys, A/D or a swipe to line up with one of three port positions, then press Space or tap Flip to turn it over.

A correct insertion breaks the computer apart and raises the next speed by 5%. A miss ends the run. Your nickname stays on the device, and scores save automatically. Browse the shared leaderboard and attempt history, with a tutorial available on desktop and mobile.

line_zh: 把旅行收进纸质文件夹，翻看城市与地点，再用照片、贴纸和手绘拼出一页回忆。
line_en: Collect trips in paper folders, browse places, and build a page of memories with photos, stickers and drawing.
lead_zh:
以纸质文件夹为灵感的旅行手账，内置巴黎、马尔代夫、巴塞罗那、巴厘岛、东京和迪拜六组示例旅行。可以搜索相册、查看地点笔记，也可以从时间线回看行程。

拼贴编辑器支持拖动素材、添加贴纸、编辑文字、导入本机照片和自由涂画，并可播放拼贴幻灯片。整个网页由一个 HTML 文件组成，无需安装或构建；编辑内容只保留在当前浏览器会话中，刷新后会重置。
lead_en:
A travel journal inspired by paper folders, with six sample trips: Paris, the Maldives, Barcelona, Bali, Tokyo and Dubai. Search albums, explore place notes or revisit trips on the timeline.

The collage editor supports dragging items, stickers, editable text, local photo import and freehand drawing, plus a collage slideshow. Everything runs from one HTML file with no installation or build step. Edits last only for the current browser session and reset after a reload.

line_zh: 从冲压到总装，用细密的等轴测图形看汽车工厂如何运转。原作：Senthee / 吴斌。
line_en: Follow a car factory from stamping to final assembly through detailed isometric scenes. Created by Senthee / Wu Bin.
lead_zh:
收藏自 Senthee / 吴斌的 Factory Anatomy。包含冲压、焊装、涂装、总装、电池包和电驱六类场景，以及三合一电驱总成爆炸图，共七个独立交互网页。

作品基于 Anatomy 绘图工具，以 SVG 组织设备和零件，用 JavaScript 驱动机械臂、输送线及物料流转。冲压示例展示五机同步、5 秒一冲、8 件满架后由 AGV 运走的动作节拍。大场景建议在桌面浏览器打开。

本条目为开源作品收藏；原作者为 Senthee / 吴斌与协作助手，绘图工具来自 Ryan 的 Anatomy，均按 MIT 许可提供。在线体验与源码链接均指向原项目。
lead_en:
An open-source project collected from Senthee / Wu Bin. Explore six factory areas—stamping, body shop, paint shop, final assembly, battery pack and electric drive—plus an exploded 3-in-1 drive unit, across seven standalone interactive pages.

Built with the Anatomy drawing kit, SVG parts form the equipment while JavaScript drives robot arms, conveyors and material flow. The stamping demo synchronizes five presses on a five-second cycle, with an AGV collecting each rack of eight parts. Desktop browsers are recommended for the large scenes.

This is a collected project by Senthee / Wu Bin and assistants, using Ryan's Anatomy kit. Both are MIT-licensed. The experience and source links lead to the original project.

line_zh: 让 AI 用可交互的机械、仪器与立体图解讲清一个原理。原作：Ryan / wheresryan22。
line_en: An AI coding skill for explaining ideas through interactive machines, instruments and isometric diagrams. By Ryan / wheresryan22.
lead_zh:
收藏自 Ryan / wheresryan22 的 Anatomy 开源技能，也是 Factory Anatomy 使用的绘图工具来源。它为 AI 编程助手提供绘制规范、零件工具、完整示例，以及截图和几何检查方法。

核心以三维坐标构造零件，再投影为带明暗与遮挡的 SVG；需要火焰、水面或发光时，可叠加 WebGL。适用于机构原理、产品拆解和交互式技术图解，可输出独立 HTML、SVG 或 React / Next.js 组件。

本机已安装，可在 Codex 中用 $anatomy 加上具体需求调用。预览图为原项目示例，包括发动机、波纹水槽与旋钮机构；本条目为开源技能收藏，原作者为 Ryan，采用 MIT 许可。
lead_en:
An open-source skill by Ryan / wheresryan22, whose drawing kit also powers Factory Anatomy. It gives AI coding assistants visual rules, part-building tools, complete examples, and methods for screenshot and geometry checks.

Parts are defined in 3D coordinates and projected into shaded, depth-ordered SVG. Optional WebGL layers add fire, water and light. Use it for mechanisms, product breakdowns and interactive technical explainers, delivered as standalone HTML, SVG or React / Next.js components.

Installed in my local Codex environment; invoke it with $anatomy followed by a concrete brief. Preview images show the original project's engine, ripple-tank and dial examples. This is a collected skill created by Ryan and released under the MIT license.
host: GitHub · 官方文档 / Official docs

line_zh: 一键展开汽车，把车身、座舱、电池和底盘逐层拆开，再让每个零件回到原位。
line_en: Take a car apart with one click, explore its body, cabin, battery and chassis, then bring every part home.
lead_zh:
从一辆完整的 Model 3 开始，用一键拆解或滑块展开 73 个独立部件。拖动旋转、滚轮缩放，也可以在八类系统之间筛选，隐藏车身观察内部结构。

点选零件可查看名称与所属系统、单独显示，并调整它的展开方向；一键组装后，零件准确回到原位。支持线框查看、保存视图和手机触屏操作。

内置汽车是简化参考模型，非原厂工程数据，用于结构交互展示。
lead_en:
Start with a complete Model 3 and use one-click disassembly or the slider to separate 73 independent parts. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, browse eight systems, or hide the body to reveal the structure inside.

Select a part to see its name and system, isolate it, or adjust its explosion direction. One-click assembly returns every part to its original position. Wireframe, saved views and touch controls are supported.

The built-in car is a simplified reference model for interactive exploration, rather than factory engineering data.

line_zh: 42 秒一镜到底，一只橙色像素光标带你逛完 Sugar 求职系统，画面和音效全部由代码生成。
line_en: A 42-second single take: a little orange pixel cursor tours the Sugar job-hunt system. Every frame and every sound is generated in code.
lead_zh:
为我的求职网站 www.sugarv.mom 做的宣传片。橙色像素光标小人从桌面醒来，打开网站后一分为四，分别展开简历库、公司库、总览、面试日历 + Offer 管理；再把内容拖到时间线上，投递 → 面试 → Offer 三个节点踩着节拍依次亮起。最后时间线变成向上的轨迹，小人一路滑过四个成果，收成一句「让求职更有节奏」。

整片只有一个连续镜头。每一帧只由时间决定，用 Playwright 逐帧截图、ffmpeg 合成；节拍音效也是程序合成的，重音对准三个节点亮起的瞬间。画面里没有任何真实账号数据，图表都是示意。
lead_en:
A promo film for my job-hunt site, www.sugarv.mom. A little orange pixel cursor wakes up on the desktop, opens the site and splits into four to open the resume library, company library, overview, and interview calendar + offer manager. The clones drag their content onto a timeline, where Apply → Interview → Offer light up on the beat. The timeline then bends into a rising track, the cursor rides past all four results, and everything gathers into one line: give your job hunt a rhythm.

The whole film is one continuous shot. Every frame depends only on time; Playwright captures it frame by frame and ffmpeg assembles the video. The beat track is synthesized in code as well, with accents landing exactly as each node lights up. No real account data appears on screen, and every chart is illustrative.

line_zh: 用石头看见磁盘空间，在毛玻璃石头与 3D 热力柱之间切换。
line_en: See disk space as frosted stones, or switch to an interactive 3D heatmap.
lead_zh: Windows 桌面版扫描真实磁盘，以不规则石头展示文件夹大小，并缓存扫描结果；可连接自己的 DeepSeek API 获取清理建议，由用户确认后移入回收站。网页使用固定的三盘五分类数据展示石头布局与 3D 热力柱，支持选择、搜索、视角切换与旋转缩放，不访问本机文件。GitHub 仓库提供 Windows x64 免安装便携包与中文安装说明。
lead_en: The Windows desktop app scans real disks, maps folders to irregular stones and caches completed scans. Optional DeepSeek analysis suggests cleanup candidates; files move to the Recycle Bin only after user confirmation. The website previews stone and 3D heatmap layouts using fixed data for three disks and five categories, with search, selection, view switching and orbit controls. It does not access local files. The GitHub repository provides a portable Windows x64 download and installation instructions.

line_zh: 收集简约网站、精致交互和产品 UI，慢慢建立自己的审美。
line_en: Collect minimal websites, thoughtful interactions and product UI.
lead_zh: 一个暖白、低饱和的 UI 灵感空间。收录 9 个公开设计参考，支持搜索、分类、收藏、添加链接与笔记，以及 JSON 导入导出。封面为索引设计，点击卡片可访问原作。每位访客的新增、收藏与笔记只保存在自己的浏览器，不会公开或跨设备同步。
lead_en: A calm gallery of nine public design references, with search, categories, favorites, personal notes and JSON import/export. Index covers link to the original work. Each visitor’s additions and notes stay in their own browser and are not published or synced.

line_zh: 从 62 个网站案例里，寻找简约设计、交互动效和 UI 灵感。
line_en: Explore 62 website references for minimal design, interactions and UI.
lead_zh: 收录 2026 年 11 月 8 日的 62 个 Awwwards 网站案例，配有 30 张截图。可以按设计方向和标签筛选，搜索网站，查看评分和设计亮点，并访问原站。收藏、笔记和手动收录在当前打开期间保留。截图与案例内容归原作者及其来源所有。
lead_en: Explore 62 Awwwards website references from November 8, 2026, with 30 screenshots. Search for sites, filter by design direction or tag, check ratings and design highlights, and visit the original sites. Favorites, notes and manually added sites are available for the current session. Screenshots and featured work belong to their original creators and sources.

line_zh: 大家都在用 HTML 和 SVG 画鹈鹕骑车，这次是真实路径追踪：2.4 万根羽毛、一辆真能转的自行车，和一条被吃掉的鱼。
line_en: Everyone draws this one in HTML and SVG. This one is path-traced: 24,000 feathers, a bicycle that really works, and one unlucky fish.
lead_zh:
每次有新模型发布，大家都拿“鹈鹕骑自行车”来测试，结果几乎都是 HTML 和 SVG 动画。这部短片换了一种做法：由 Claude Opus 5.5 编写脚本，在 Blender Cycles 里从零建模并路径追踪，起点是下面这段提示词。

天空来自一个用 Rust 写的体积云渲染器；白鹈鹕身上约 2.4 万根羽毛逐根生成，按真实的羽区排列；自行车有 36 根交叉编织的辐条和 92 节会运转的链条；配乐和音效全部由程序合成。792 帧在一块 GTX 1650 Ti 上渲染了约 9 小时。

提示词：
每次有新模型发布，大家都让它画“一只骑自行车的鹈鹕”来判断空间能力，而且几乎都是用 HTML 和 SVG 做动画。我真的看腻了，所以我想让你做出最复杂、最精细、最漂亮的“鹈鹕骑自行车”动画视频。什么技术都可以用。不着急，你可以花一整天来画。
lead_en:
Every time a new model comes out, everyone tests it with "a pelican riding a bicycle", and nearly every answer is an HTML and SVG animation. This short takes another route: Claude Opus 5.5 wrote the scripts, then modelled and path-traced everything from scratch in Blender Cycles, starting from the prompt below.

The sky comes from a volumetric cloud renderer written in Rust. The great white pelican wears about 24,000 individually generated feathers, laid out in real feather tracts. The bicycle has 36 laced spokes and 92 working chain links, and the score and sound effects are all synthesized in code. The 792 frames took about 9 hours on a single GTX 1650 Ti.

Prompt:
Every time a new model comes out, everyone has it draw "a pelican riding a bicycle" to judge its spatial ability, and it's almost always animated with HTML and SVG. I'm honestly tired of looking at them, so I want you to make the most complex, most detailed, most beautiful animated video of "a pelican riding a bicycle". You can use any technology. There's no rush; you can spend a whole day drawing it.
